# Keelbase

> Keelbase is the platform for launching and running an AI-native business. Founders describe their idea in a single conversation; Keelbase configures the crew, governance, payments, and hands them a running operation.

## What Keelbase Is

Keelbase deploys self-operating businesses called Vessels. Each Vessel has its own crew of specialists, a governed treasury, an activity log of every decision the crew makes, and a founder who sets the direction and approves decisions that exceed defined boundaries.

A Vessel is not a chatbot, a workflow builder, or a no-code tool. It is a company that runs itself — with the founder as the owner and decision-maker, and the crew handling operations.

## The Three Core Components

### The Architect
The Architect is the conversational setup session that builds a Vessel. A founder describes their business in plain language. The Architect asks questions about workflows, governance, and spend boundaries, then configures and deploys the Vessel. One session. No code required.

### Mira
Mira is the founder's permanent Liaison — the interface to the Vessel once it is running. Available in the dashboard and on Telegram. Mira surfaces what needs the founder's attention, delivers a daily briefing, routes instructions to the crew, and presents decisions that need founder approval in the 2do queue.

### The Crew
Specialist members configured to the founder's business — research, outreach, operations, client workflows, finance. The crew runs the operation within the boundaries the founder set during the Architect session. Anything outside those boundaries is escalated to the founder via Mira.

## Key Terminology

- **Vessel** — a Keelbase-deployed self-operating business
- **Mira** — the founder's Liaison; the conversational interface to the Vessel
- **The Architect** — the setup session that configures and deploys a Vessel
- **The Crew** — the specialist members that run the Vessel's operations
- **2do queue** — the founder's decision queue; items that need approval or a choice
- **Vault** — the Vessel's treasury; shows Funds, Credits, and Spend
- **Activity log** — the permanent plain-language record of every crew action

## What Makes Keelbase Different

- Setup happens through a single conversation — no forms, no configuration screens, no technical knowledge required
- Every crew action is recorded automatically and permanently in plain language
- The crew operates within spend boundaries the founder sets; nothing above those limits moves without explicit approval
- Business context is hardware-isolated per session — not stored or used to train models
- The founder's role is three things: set the direction, make decisions when asked, talk to Mira when something needs to change

## Who Keelbase Is For

Founders who have a business idea and want it to run without managing the operations. Non-technical founders who have been excluded from the AI-native company category because they couldn't wire up the infrastructure themselves. AI-native founders who want sovereign, accountable infrastructure rather than a pile of scripts.

## Access

Keelbase is in private beta. Early access is by waitlist at keelbase.io. The first cohort is small. Founders join the waitlist and are contacted when their cohort opens.
